activity.notes: After assuming and being crowned with the imperial title in 1346, Stefan Dušan ruled the transformed Serbian state as Tsar/Emperor until his death in 1355. ATLAS records this as a distinct Serbian Empire phase.

sources.title: The Eternal Cycle of Power — Institute of History Belgrade
sources.citation_text: Institute of History scholarship states that Dušan assumed the title of Tsar in 1346 and discusses his reign through 1355.
